description: Client-side script for the 'Leave Allocation' doctype in ERPNext, managing leave allocation form behaviors, queries, and UI interactions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes form, sets default values, and query filters when the form loads.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles form refresh actions, including adding custom buttons based on expiry conditions.

methods.name: expire_allocation
methods.description: Calls server method to expire leave allocation and shows confirmation message.

methods.name: employee
methods.description: Triggers total leave calculation when employee field changes.

methods.name: leave_type
methods.description: Triggers leave policy fetch and total leave calculation when leave type changes.

methods.name: carry_forward
methods.description: Triggers total leave calculation when carry forward option changes.

methods.name: unused_leaves
methods.description: Updates total leaves allocated based on unused leaves and new leaves allocated.

methods.name: new_leaves_allocated
methods.description: Updates total leaves allocated based on new leaves allocated and unused leaves.

methods.name: leave_policy
methods.description: Fetches leave policy details and updates new leaves allocated.

methods.name: calculate_total_leaves_allocated
methods.description: Calculates total leaves allocated based on carry forward option and other fields.
